'''Harmony Lake''' was a lake located on<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="BimmWhere">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Saari Ha system|Bimmisaari system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]].<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Harmony Lake was first pictured in the [[1998]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and illustrated by [[Brandon McKinney]] and [[Scott Kolins]].<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo" />
